scope: Synthetic Chrome runtime and management API; no live hospital network or native extension installation
checks: First opening requires computer registration before any Portal query
Enrollment input accepts only four digits and provides a numeric keyboard
Name and one-time code register successfully; only allowed device metadata is transmitted
Remote disable locks new work without altering stored pharmacy data
Update and complete local backup remain accessible while disabled
Restoring a device unlocks it after the next verified reply
A policy received during editing waits for the open operation to close and preserves its draft
A minimum-version requirement exposes the update path while blocking old-version work
Expired offline authorization blocks Portal work after reopening
